identify necessary discord bot dependencies and create a migration plan for moving to discord

to get a discord bot up and running you’ll need these core dependencies: python ecosystem python 3.10+ (latest stable) discord.py 2.3.2 (or the actively‑maintained fork py‑cord if you prefer) python‑dotenv (for loading your token from a .env file) aiohttp (async http client, comes with discord.py but good to pin) websockets (again bundled, but explicit version pinning helps reproducibility) optional but common pymongo or asyncpg (if you need a database) redis‑py (for caching / rate‑limit handling) pillow (image processing) youtube‑dl / yt‑dlp (music bots) rich (pretty console logs) dev tools black / isort (code formatting) flake8 / pylint (linting) pytest‑asyncio (async test suite) pre‑commit (hook to enforce style) --- migration plan from an existing bot to a fresh discord‑py setup | phas
